surface.method: Ride with GPS public unpaved_pct; OSM segment matching pending
surface.label: mixed_surfaces

routes.driveMethod: OSRM driving estimate from approximate home area
routes.description: Start at the Minnesota Valley National Wildlife Refuge Visitors Center.  Follow Long Meadow Lake Trail to River Valley Trail-Cedar/77 segment to River Valley Trail-West Segment until you reach the Bloomingon Ferry Unit Parking lot.  Return along the same route to the Cedar Avenue Bridge and cross the river to the Mendota Trail.  Follow the Mendota Trail to the Sibley House in Mendota.  From here follow D Street across Hwy 13 to the Big Rivers Regional Trail.  Head south on the Big Rivers Regional Trail to the 494 Bridge and cross the bridge to the Bloomington side.  Follow American Blvd. to the MNVNWR Visitors Center.

routes.name: Jeff Frane: Country Style 50 Mile

surface.method: Ride with GPS public unpaved_pct; OSM segment matching pending
surface.label: mostly_unpaved

routes.driveMethod: OSRM driving estimate from approximate home area
routes.description:
Come tour the fabulous River Bottoms with friends old and new. Gravel, pavement, bike path, two track and single track.

Any off road bike will work great, and none are a bad choice, gravel bike, mountain bike, or fat bike will all work great for this course. I'd recommend at least a 38c tire with a 42c being about optimal. This is also a great chance to put some big miles on a vintage MTB if you're into that sort of thing.

Expect to be out there about five hours and there is a gas station at mile 30 and several bars / restaurants at mile 40 in Mendota. Bring snacks!
